title: Welcome, Referee
body:
This short tutorial will take you on a journey through the Hex Realm Generator.
- Learn what the core tools are.
- Learn where you can find them.
 IMPORTANT: You can use the arrow keys to navigate through the steps.

title: Command Toolbar
body: This toolbar allows you to change the configuration of your realm. In the next steps, we'll break down each section.

title: Generate & Configure
body:
- Generate: 
 Build a fresh realm using your current settings.
- Settings: 
 Open granular generation options to tune grid size, grid type, how the terrain is generated, and how new myths are placed.
- Grid: adjust grid color, spacing, and visibility on the fly.

title: View Modes
body:
- Referee vs. Knight: toggle visibility layers for GM or player reveals.
- Eye settings: open detailed visibility controls like icon overlays and myths.

title: Realm Presets
body: Open curated generation themes and color palettes. Preview before you commit and jump into settings when you need deeper tweaks.

title: Preset Browser
body:
- Preview: hover to inspect terrain layouts instantly.
- Apply: lock in a combination of generation + color presets.
- Deep dive: open settings directly from here for fine control.

title: Import & Export Realm Data
body:
- Import Realm Data: load saved realms or player-facing maps.
- Export Realm Data: capture the entire state as a JSON archive.

title: Export Realm PNG
body: Open the PNG export modal to frame your map, tweak overlays, and download a polished image for handouts or VTT uploads.

title: Export Preview
body:
- Toggle overlays like grid, icons, and spray.
- Switch referee/knight visibility to control spoilers.
- Download the exact preview shown on the right.

title: Realm Canvas
body: Pan, zoom, and click to inspect or paint hexes. Everything you place on this map updates live with your current tool.

title: Tools Palette
body:
- Shortcuts 1–5 jump directly to each tool.
- Active tool matches the sidebar docked on the right.
- Use the palette anywhere on the map without moving your cursor far.

title: Select Tool
body:
- Inspect hex details, change holdings, and attach myths.
- Great for editing existing terrain without painting over it.

title: Selection Sidebar
body:
Edit whichever hex is selected.
- Update terrain notes and structures.
- Toggle tooltip hints for quick reference during play.

title: Terrain Painter
body:
- Paint terrain types hex by hex.
- Sample existing colors with the pipette and adjust clusters quickly.

title: Terrain Sidebar
body:
- Change swatches, upload custom icons, and manage spray overlays.
- Choose brush characters for labeling exported maps.

title: Barrier Painter
body:
- Draw rivers, walls, or magical boundaries.
- Click and drag to trace edges between hexes.

title: Barrier Sidebar
body:
- Choose barrier colors and thickness.
- Switch between adding or erasing with a single toggle.

title: POI Painter
body:
- Place holdings, landmarks, and travel icons.
- Customize icon colors to match your campaign aesthetic.

title: POI Sidebar
body:
- Configure icon styles, backdrops, and spray effects.
- Quickly swap between your saved tile sets.

title: Myth Tool
body:
- Drop narrative hooks, legendary sites, and quest starters.
- Relocate myths with drag-and-drop to adjust pacing.

title: Myth Sidebar
body:
- Track myth details, mark seats of power, and tweak marker styles.
- Store enough lore to run an entire session from a single panel.

title: Quick Save Slots
body:
- Snapshot your entire realm state into quick slots.
- Enable local storage to persist between sessions.
- Rename slots to track different story beats.

title: Undo & Redo
body:
- Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y or these buttons step through edits.
- Undo painting, myth placement, or imports safely.

title: Tour Complete
body:
You now know the lay of the land.
- Explore presets to jumpstart a new realm.
- Use tool + sidebar pairs to iterate quickly.
- Export when you are ready to wow your table.
